Bring the links, context, and next steps into one client-ready page, then send one clear link instead of stitching the handover together in email. Publish one page. The receiver opens it. Thats it for them. No account, no portal, no login. Free during beta. Start speaking. 4x faster. Try Wispr Flow: Dictation That Works Everywhere Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Russell Privett Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt! We built Handover because every project seems to need a spaghetti mess of links sent. A Slack message with a dozen links. A follow-up email asking for the final files again. A delivery that felt improvised. Handover gives that last step a better shape. You add the important links — Figma, Notion, Loom, Drive, Dropbox, any URL — publish one page, and send a single link. Your client opens it and has the work, the context, and the next step in front of them. No account, nothing to learn. It’s built for freelancers, agencies, and creators who already have a stack they like, but want the final send to feel more considered. The link stays the same as the project evolves, and the handover becomes the record of what was delivered. It’s free during the beta, and we would especially love feedback on two things: - What still feels messy in your current handover process - What would make a handover page genuinely useful in your workflow Upvote (1) Report Share 24h ago

Try Wispr Flow: Dictation That Works Everywhere Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment AW Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I built Publia to scratch a very specific itch: my AI assistant could make something great — a landing page, a one-pager, a little site — but the last step, getting it online at a real link, was always the annoying part. Hosting, configs, deploys… for a single page. It killed the momentum. So Publia does one thing: what AI makes, Publia ships. Add the skill to the assistant you already use — Claude or Codex — once: npx skills@latest add getpublia/skills Then just say "publish this." Your assistant builds the page and hands you back a real, shareable link at your own address: you.publia.sh. No setup, no server, no dashboard. No AI handy? You can also drag files straight into publia.ai, or push a folder from the terminal (npx publia-cli upload ./site). A few things I care about: Real web pages, not chat exports — full HTML, images, layout, auto-HTTPS. Try Wispr Flow: Dictation That Works Everywhere Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Katherine Xuan Subotiz Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt! 👋 AI and SaaS teams can now build and ship products faster than ever. But turning a product into predictable global revenue is still surprisingly difficult. The moment you start charging users, you inherit a whole new stack of problems: pricing, subscriptions, global payments, taxes, failed payments, refunds, disputes, retention, and reconciliation. For an early-stage team, monetization can quickly become a second product to build and maintain. That’s why we built Subotiz . Subotiz gives AI developers and SaaS companies the infrastructure to launch and manage monetization without piecing everything together from scratch. With no-code and lightweight integration options, teams can: Launch subscriptions, credits, usage-based billing, or hybrid pricing Accept global payments and manage tax and compliance Give customers self-service subscription controls Recover failed checkouts and payments Improve retention, dispute handling, and reconciliation The goal is simple: let builders focus on their product while Subotiz handles the complexity behind getting paid. Building something of your own?
